simple.meaning: פָּנַק (pânaq) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to enervate.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Proverbs, beginning at Proverbs 29:21. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.

definitions.full: H6445. panaq [ פָנַק ] verb Pi`el indulge, pamper (Late Hebrew Pi`el; compare Ecclus 14:16; Arabic II.; Aramaic פנק , Pa`el); — Participle מְפַנֵּק Prov 29:21 one pampering a servant. [ מַּס ] see פסס . דַּמִּים מַּס see ד ׳אֶפֶס .
